scripts.build:operasional: (cd apps/app1-operasional && (npm run build 2>/dev/null || bun run build))
scripts.build:owner: (cd apps/app2-owner && (npm run build 2>/dev/null || bun run build))
scripts.build:all: npm run build:operasional && npm run build:owner
scripts.build:win:all: bun run build:win:operasional && bun run build:win:owner
scripts.cap:sync:operasional: npm run build:operasional && (cd apps/app1-operasional && npx cap sync android)
scripts.cap:sync:owner: npm run build:owner && (cd apps/app2-owner && npx cap sync android)
scripts.cap:sync:all: npm run build:all && (cd apps/app1-operasional && npx cap sync android) && (cd apps/app2-owner && npx cap sync android)
